description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for handling ticket upload endpoints in a Spring Boot application. It exposes a POST endpoint /api/tickets/upload that accepts an Excel file, processes it to compute ticket metrics, and returns the metrics as JSON. The class is annotated for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: TicketUploadController
classes.description: Spring REST Controller for uploading ticket Excel files, processing them to compute metrics, and returning the results. It is mapped to the /api/tickets path and provides the /upload endpoint.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload an Excel file. Calls the ticketMetricsService to process the uploaded file and returns a list of TicketMetric objects in JSON format.
